records.publishedClaimUsed: Slewing-bearing mounting structure flatness and rigidity materially affect load distribution, running torque and bearing life; mounting and fastening must follow bearing-specific requirements.
records.selectionImpact: Supports explicit flatness/rigidity/fastener/preload RFQ requirements. Does not select a Kaydon bearing or establish VX4800 load capacity.

records.publishedClaimUsed: Bearing mounting faces require controlled flatness after welding/stress relief; tighter mounting control may be required for low rotational resistance or high precision.
records.selectionImpact: Supports post-weld machining and mounted runout/torque verification requirements. Exact tolerances remain tied to the eventual bearing family/variant.

records.publishedClaimUsed: Synchronous-belt installation tension must be designed for the drive; overtension increases bearing/shaft load while undertension can cause ratcheting and transient separation forces.
records.selectionImpact: Supports treating belt pretension and tangential/separation forces as structural/bearing inputs. Does not select a Gates belt family, width or tension value.

records.publishedClaimUsed: RINGSPANN publishes spring-activated, electromagnetically released brake-caliper families, demonstrating an industrial fixed-caliper/power-off brake architecture suitable for further application study.
records.selectionImpact: Supports the direct-carrier spring-applied/electrically released brake family study only. No RINGSPANN model, brake force, torque or safety performance is selected or claimed.

records.publishedClaimUsed: HEIDENHAIN modular angle encoders pair circular scales or scale drums with separate scanning heads, including optical and magnetic architectures.
records.selectionImpact: Supports a fixed scanning-head plus passive rotating scale/drum architecture without requiring powered rotating electronics. No encoder family, resolution or functional-safety claim is selected.

records.publishedClaimUsed: The TTR ECA 4400 is a scale drum for an absolute angle encoder without integral bearing, confirming a passive rotating scale component can be mechanically separated from its scanning electronics.
records.selectionImpact: Architecture precedent only. The published 560.46 mm scale-drum variant is not selected and its accuracy/speed capability is not a VX4800 requirement.

researchDiscipline: Manufacturer evidence is recorded as published evidence, not an engineering calculation or prototype result.
A source can justify an RFQ requirement or candidate family without closing a product promotion gate.
Exact variant data must be rechecked at supplier selection and must not be mixed between families or variants.
Supplier component certifications or functional-safety options do not certify the complete VX4800 kinetic mechanism.
selectionRule: No record in this evidence index constitutes component selection. Selection remains blocked until controlled VX4800 mass/load/fault inputs exist and exact variants are evaluated against them.
